title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-08-01 06:10:52 最新章节：2645 不按套路出牌
slug: 从小欢喜开启诸天之旅
content_zh:
京都，春风中学。
夏日炎炎，头顶烈日正肆无忌惮的灼烧大地，今日京都最高温度突破了42℃的大关。
校园里，藏身于绿油油草丛里的知了叽叽喳喳叫个不停，令人心里不免有些烦躁。
“汤校长，那陆泽我可就交给您了。”
“好说好说，这孩子...”
校长办公室，陆泽安静的站在一旁，默默听着舅舅刘铮跟汤校长谈话，他时不时的冲二人微笑点头致意，宛如乖乖学生。
今天是他来到小欢喜世界刚好两个月的日子，也是春风中学高三年级开学的日子。
两个月前，陆泽遭遇车祸离世，再度醒来后发现自己来到了小欢喜的世界。
他变成了季杨杨的表哥，小欢喜里温柔善良的刘静成了他的小姨，面前这個正跟春风中学校长有说有笑的是他的舅舅刘铮。
跟着陆泽一起穿越过来的还有影视世界穿梭系统。
陆泽默默唤醒脑海里的系统。
【宿主：陆泽】
【当前所处世界：小欢喜】
【身份：父母因车祸双双身亡、转学至春风中学的高三学生】
【精神：7】
【体质：6】
【力量：5】
【敏捷：5】
【技能：驾驶入门LV1（本本族）；厨艺入门LV1（西红柿炒蛋专业户）】
【系统可分配点数：0】

影视世界穿梭系统，旨在令宿主穿越于各个影视世界，体验各种光怪陆离的人生，并在其中获得圆满度评级。
只有最终的评级达到70%才可以完美的穿越至下一个世界。
在完成一个影视世界评级以后，宿主还可以利用系统点数兑换主动穿梭卡，回到离开这个世界前的时间点。
这是陆泽目前了解到的系统基本信息。
直到他今天转学来到春风中学，算是正式开启了小欢喜世界的剧情。
......
交谈结束，陆泽跟舅舅刘铮离开了校长办公室。
一出门就是一股热浪扑面而来，室内外温差极大，京都半湿润半干旱季风气候使得这里在夏天非常容易出现高温情况。
校园里来来往往的人们都是尽量走在学校建筑下的阴凉处。
办公室门口，刘铮轻轻的拍了拍陆泽的肩膀，扭头嘱咐道：
“行了，事情都办完了，你以后就放心的在这边好好学习，没事的时候让你弟弟带着你熟悉一下学校的环境。”
“还有啊，平时遇上什么事情记得跟舅舅打电话，记住了没？”
刘铮宠溺的揉了揉陆泽的头。
他有两个外甥。
一个季杨杨，跟父母之间的关系势同水火，是他当成半大儿子一直带到大。
而面前这个外甥更令人唏嘘，父母两个人前段时间竟是双双离世，只留下了这孤苦伶仃的孩子。
这孩子刚好有着京都户口，刘铮跟姐姐一合计，干脆就让他转学到他们身边来，度过高三这特殊的时期。
陆泽感受到了舅舅对于自己的关心，心里一股暖流流过。
他轻声道：“知道啦，舅舅。”
content_en:
Kyoto, Chunfeng Middle School.
Summer is scorching hot, and the scorching sun above our heads is scorching the earth unbridled. Today, the highest temperature in Kyoto exceeded the 42°C mark.
On campus, the cicadas hiding in the green grass kept chirping, which made people feel a little irritable.
"Principal Tang, I will leave Lu Ze to you."
"It's easy to talk, this kid..."
In the principal's office, Lu Ze stood quietly, listening silently to his uncle Liu Zheng's conversation with Principal Tang. From time to time, he smiled and nodded at the two of them, just like an obedient student.
Today is exactly two months since he came to Little Happy World, and it is also the day when the third grade of Chunfeng Middle School begins.
Two months ago, Lu Ze died in a car accident. When he woke up again, he found himself in Xiao Huanxi's world.
He became Ji Yangyang's cousin, the gentle and kind Liu Jing in Xiao Huanxi became his aunt, and the person in front of him who was talking and laughing with the principal of Chunfeng Middle School was his uncle Liu Zheng.
Also traveling through time with Lu Ze was the film and television world shuttle system.
Lu Ze silently awakened the system in his mind.
[Host: Lu Ze]
[Current World: Little Joy]
[Identity: A senior high school student who transferred to Chunfeng Middle School after his parents died in a car accident]
【Spirit: 7】
[Physique: 6]
【Strength: 5】
[Agility: 5]
[Skills: LV1 for beginners in driving (for this family); LV1 for beginners in cooking (professional with tomatoes and scrambled eggs)]
[The system can allocate points: 0]
The film and television world shuttle system is designed to allow the host to travel through various film and television worlds, experience various bizarre lives, and obtain a satisfaction rating among them.
Only when the final rating reaches 70% can you perfectly travel to the next world.
After completing a film and television world rating, the host can also use system points to redeem an active shuttle card and return to the time before leaving this world.
This is the basic information about the system that Lu Ze has learned so far.
Until he transferred to Chunfeng Middle School today, the story of Little Happy World officially started.
...
After the conversation ended, Lu Ze and his uncle Liu Zheng left the principal's office.
As soon as you step out, a heat wave hits your face. The temperature difference between indoor and outdoor is huge. Kyoto's semi-humid and semi-arid monsoon climate makes it very prone to high temperatures in summer.
People coming and going on campus try to walk in the shade under the school buildings.
At the door of the office, Liu Zheng patted Lu Ze gently on the shoulder, turned around and said:
"Okay, everything is done. You can study hard here with peace of mind. When you have nothing to do, let your brother take you to familiarize yourself with the school environment."
"Also, if you encounter anything, remember to call your uncle. Do you remember?"
Liu Zheng rubbed Lu Ze's head lovingly.
He has two nephews.
Ji Yangyang's relationship with his parents was on the same level, and he was the one who brought him up as a half-eldest son.
The nephew in front of him is even more embarrassing. Both his parents passed away some time ago, leaving only this lonely child.
This child happened to have a Kyoto household registration, so Liu Zheng and his sister decided to let him transfer to them to spend the special period of his senior year in high school.
Lu Ze felt his uncle's concern for him, and a warm current flowed through his heart.
He whispered: "I know, uncle."
